coordinate_contract.rotation: R_Csource_Etarget = dR_Csource @ R_Csource_Esource (left multiply, right-hand rule)
coordinate_contract.translation: dp is expressed in transition source camera C[source]

data_contract.camera_delta: state-derived endpoint from packed camera state80; packed camera motion80 is used only for hidden one-step validation
data_contract.eef_delta: state-derived endpoint from packed EEF state80; packed motion80 is used only for hidden one-step validation
data_contract.time_indexing: motion80[target] stores source->target; spatial basis C[source]

visual_contract.camera_card: sign schematic only; not an RGB projection or magnitude scale
visual_contract.dashed_triad: target packed state80 E pose transformed into source camera
visual_contract.gray_dashed_triad: raw absolute EEF pose projected with supplied T_world_camera; no renderer-side axis correction

window_failure_reasons: hidden rows are not one contiguous transition window
